newsitem.title: USA: Kerr-Mcgee unit signs two deals with Yemen.
newsitem.headline: Kerr-Mcgee unit signs two deals with Yemen.

text.p: Kerr-McGee Corp said on Thursday that its Yemen subsidiary signed two production-sharing agreements with Yemen and the country's government-owned oil company.
Kerr-McGee Yemen Ltd will be the operator of East Al Hajar (Block 51) and Hazar (Block 50), covering about 10 million acres.
Kerr-McGee will have a working interest of 87.5 percent in Block 51 and 95 percent in Block 50.
Kerr-McGee said the deal brings its gross undeveloped acreage worldwide to more than 16 million acres.
